The three state parts stay asserted via tripleStateCard.getByTestId('strategy-triple-lifecycle'), tripleStateCard.getByTestId('strategy-triple-review'), and tripleStateCard.getByTestId('strategy-triple-deployment'), so the spec passes in both zh-TW and en-US.

npm run lint reports 0 errors (0 errors, 131 warnings) and tsc passes across tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.agora.json.

changed_assertions.what: Replaced page.getByText('Strategy state · lifecycle × review × deployment', { exact: true }) and page.getByText('lifecycle' | 'review' | 'deployment', { exact: true }) with page.getByTestId('strategy-triple-state-card') and child getByTestId('strategy-triple-lifecycle' | 'strategy-triple-review' | 'strategy-triple-deployment').
changed_assertions.why: FE-STRATEGY-DETAIL-PLAIN-WORDS-20261125 localized the Strategy State block on StrategyDetail in zh-TW ('策略狀態（生命週期 × 審查 × 部署）') and en-US ('Strategy state (lifecycle × review × deployment)'). Asserting the card and its three parts by their data-testid attributes keeps the exact 3-part state block check while working across both zh-TW and en-US locales.
